news.title:
Exchange Summon Points 
for Summon Point Tickets!
news.summary: * Added information on the upcoming new lineups. Updated information on the upcoming new lineups of the Summon Events where Summon Point Tickets can be used!

bodies.description:
Information on the upcoming new lineups
that will become available starting from Fri. 11/27 UTC
has been added!

Summon Points can be obtained by performing
Multi-Summons with Dragon Stones!

Collect Summon Points and exchange them for
Summon Point Tickets that allow you to recruit
characters who have appeared in Summon Events
such as Dokkan Festivals, Legendary Summons
and Legendary Summon Carnivals!

= How to Obtain Summon Points =

Summon Points can be obtained by performing
a Multi-Summon with Dragon Stones in certain
Summon Events (up to the 3rd Multi-Summon).

- Related Summon Events
Summon Events that feature new characters,
such as Dokkan Festivals, Legendary Summons
and Legendary Summon Carnivals.

The amount of obtainable Summon Points differs
between Summon Events. Please check the
announcements of the Summon Events for more
information.

When Multi-Summon discounts are available,
during which the text "Only XX:XX:XX" is displayed,
Summon Points can be obtained at the following timings.

1.
The first 3 Multi-Summons performed with
Dragon Stones during the period in which
the text "Only XX:XX:XX" is displayed.

2.
The first 3 Multi-Summons performed with
Dragon Stones after the discount period ends.

Please note that Summon Points cannot be obtained
starting from the 4th Multi-Summon performed in the
above periods nor by performing a free Multi-Summon.

* Please note that if the text "Only XX:XX:XX" is not
displayed, you will not get a free Multi-Summon for
three Multi-Summons performed.

= How to Use Summon Points =

300 Summon Points can be exchanged for a
"Summon Point Ticket (Dokkan Festival)" or
a "Summon Point Ticket (Carnival)" at the
"Treasure" section of Baba's Shop. The tickets
can be used to perform summons in the
corresponding Summon Events.

- Summon Events where Summon Point Tickets can be used
- Dokkan Festival [Summon Point Ticket]
- Legendary Summon Carnival [Summon Point Ticket]

* Please check the announcements "Dokkan Festival
[Summon Point Ticket]!" and "Legendary Summon
Carnival [Summon Point Ticket]!" for more information
on the characters available in the ongoing Summon Events.

* From Fri. 11/20 15:00 UTC until the next
Summon Events become available, you can exchange
Summon Points for Summon Point Tickets at Baba's Shop.
Please note that Summon Point Ticket Summons will not
be available during this period.

* Please navigate the following path to check the Summon
Points you have: "Team" --> "Items" --> "Treasure".

= Upcoming New Lineups =

- Dokkan Festival [Summon Point Ticket]
Scheduled to include characters who are only available
in Dokkan Festivals and have made their debuts during
the following period:
January 2026 - July 2026

- Certain featured characters
